metadata.title: Assessment Plan: sample-gcp, SC-28 + SC-28(1) automated checks
metadata.remarks: Automated assessment of the infrastructure definition (main.tf, parsed with python-hcl2), not of the deployed resources. Same rules, objectives and OPA checks as the sample-azure plan; only the adapter differs. Each activity tests one rule from the datastore-checks component definition (Rule_Id prop) and names the objectives its result is evidence for; automation/result2oscal.py uses that mapping to turn OPA results into findings.

activities.title: Test encryption at rest
activities.description: Evaluate rule datastore_encrypted_at_rest against the datastore inventory produced from the infrastructure definition.

steps.title: Produce the datastore inventory
steps.description: Parse main.tf and run the GCP adapter (automation/gcp_terraform_inventory.py).

steps.title: Evaluate the check
steps.description: Evaluate data.datastores.encryption_at_rest.deny with OPA; every datastore must be absent from the deny set.

activities.title: Test tamper evidence
activities.description: Evaluate rule datastore_tamper_evident against the datastore inventory produced from the infrastructure definition.

steps.title: Produce the datastore inventory
steps.description: Parse main.tf and run the GCP adapter (automation/gcp_terraform_inventory.py).

steps.title: Evaluate the check
steps.description: Evaluate data.datastores.tamper_evidence.deny with OPA; every datastore must be absent from the deny set.

local-definitions.remarks: Not covered by this plan: examining key management (CMEK is not declared, so Google-managed keys apply) and any tamper-evidence mechanism added outside Firestore. Those would be EXAMINE activities against the running system.

components.title: Open Policy Agent
components.description: OPA v1.22.4 (tools/opa.exe) evaluating the policies selected from policies/datastores by automation/oscal2policy.py.

components.title: GCP adapter
components.description: automation/gcp_terraform_inventory.py: parses main.tf with python-hcl2 and maps google_firestore_database resources to the datastore inventory (policies/schemas/datastore-inventory.schema.json).

tasks.title: Run the automated SC-28 checks
tasks.description: Run automation/run_assessment.py gcp, which performs both activities and writes the assessment results.
